svg.title: Contribution Observatory / TENSORKAI
svg.desc: 975 contributions across 95 active days in 365 days. Longest streak: 10 days. Past 30 days: 273; past 7 days: 136. Each radial mark is one UTC day; its length scales with the square root of the daily count.
svg.text: Proof of work. In living color.
One mark. One day. A year of making.
